weeks.name: Pep Rally
weeks.intro: Week one. The school is preparing for a pep rally. Someone has hung the banner upside down.
weeks.bossIntro: The bleachers groan. Center stage, under a single flickering light, the school mascot stands up. There's nobody inside it.

reward.narrate: The Hollow Mascot folds in on itself like an empty costume, which it is. The cheering stops. Somewhere in the real town, a pep rally banner falls down. Kelly will say she felt it.

hints.force: The air feels heavy, like the whole school is holding its breath.
hints.light: The lights in the gym hum louder than they should.
hints.cold: There's frost on the inside of the lockers.
hints.motion: Papers blow down halls with no draft.

weeks.sundayTease: Next week, Gary's freezer starts making a noise like breathing. Bring something warm.

weeks.name: The Cold Cut
weeks.intro: Week two. Others are being pulled in now. Gary's freezer frosts over every night.
weeks.bossIntro: The deli's walk-in freezer door swings open on its own. Something made of frozen meat and bad intentions shuffles out, wearing Gary's apron.

reward.narrate: The Cold Cut shatters like dropped ice. In the real deli, the freezer goes quiet for the first time in days. Gary doesn't know why he's crying a little.

hints.cold: Gary's freezer frosts over every night, even unplugged.
hints.force: Windows rattle in their frames downtown.
hints.heat: The forge burns hotter to keep the chill off.

weeks.sundayTease: The forge went cold for a few minutes tonight. The blacksmith hasn't stopped hammering since.

weeks.name: The Forge Revenant
weeks.intro: Week three. People are disappearing. The forge goes cold, then too hot. Mr. B has started making announcements about 'transfers'.
weeks.bossIntro: In the mirrored forge, the fire stands up. It has the blacksmith's shoulders and none of his patience.

reward.narrate: The Forge Revenant collapses into cooling slag shaped like a man with a hammer. In town, the forge relights itself. The blacksmith says 'about time' to nobody.

hints.heat: The forge burns white-hot at night with nobody there.
hints.binding: Chains in the hardware store tangle themselves.
hints.cold: Ice forms around the forge's chimney.
hints.light: Sparks hang in the air too long.

weeks.sundayTease: Dr. Reyes looked at the closed wing for a long time today. The door was open a crack.

weeks.name: The Night Ward
weeks.intro: Week four. The hospital's closed wing is open now, and it's full of names nobody remembers.
weeks.bossIntro: Every bed in the mirrored ward sits up at once. The thing in the doctor's coat at the end of the hall has a clipboard and no face.

reward.narrate: The Night Ward discharges itself. The beds lie down. In the real closed wing, a filing cabinet unlocks with a click, and every file inside is signed by the same vice principal.

hints.binding: Hospital doors lock from the inside.
hints.vitality: Dead flowers in the lobby bloom overnight.
hints.light: The closed wing's lights turn on by themselves.
hints.cold: Breath fogs in the waiting room.

weeks.sundayTease: The whole town looks like its reflection now. Even you. Especially you.

weeks.name: The Mirror Town
weeks.intro: Week five. The Upside-Down isn't under the town anymore. It's the town. Mr. B has stopped pretending.
weeks.bossIntro: The town square, mirrored, folds up into a shape. It wears Mr. B's face like a badge.

reward.narrate: The Mirror Town cracks down the middle, and through the crack you see the real one: morning, ordinary, a little scuffed. Someone is narrating the sunrise.

hints.heat: Everything is a little warmer than it should be.
hints.cold: Everything is a little colder than it should be.
hints.motion: Everything moves when you look away.
hints.light: Everything glows faintly, like a reflection.
